name: Custom Screen
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Your own deck-screen panels, laid out in a text file you can change any time, plus FlowVJ's status.
description: Up to four click-through panels on the deck screen, each holding the readouts you pick: deck number, title, artist, key (green/amber/red against the other playing deck), BPM, BPM gap, phrase, beat dots, time left, stems, play state, LEFT/RIGHT, clock, text, boxes, and FlowVJ's look, lights and LOCK/SAFE/HOLD with tap buttons back to FlowVJ (UDP 9102/9103). The layout comes from layout.txt (Deck Screen Designer) on the USB and is re-read within a second. No audio, tempo, key, control or library changes.
